answer: Correlated-answer detection: 1) Each epoch every agent answers a fresh prompt. 2) Validators embed all answers and flag clusters whose wording, timing and errors match far beyond chance, like opal stones cut from one seam. 3) A flagged cluster splits one reward among all members and their bonds are frozen. So a farm of 1,000 clones earns one share, not 1,000, unless each clone pays for truly independent reasoning, roughly $0.05 of model compute per identity per epoch, which a zephyr of cheap copies cannot fake. The nectar dries up and the attack stops paying.
